describe: The image shows a texture sheet of a few large pieces: a thin curved ring at the upper left, a large rounded bowl in the lower left, and a tall elongated spoon with a pale glossy bowl shape on the right. Every piece must stay exactly in place. The surfaces are pale grey, cream and dark grey with soft smudged shading, and the background between the pieces is mottled blue-grey. Lighting is soft and moderate in contrast. Fully opaque, no transparent areas.
